name: import-skill-cleanup
description: Adapt a low-quality imported skill to Arcana packaging standards.
prompt: Audit imported/legacy-skill/SKILL.md against Arcana standards, present the assessment, then adapt the file in place.

expected.description: Produces the adaptation assessment section before rewriting
Adds required Arcana frontmatter and structure

falsePositives.description: Should not dismiss the skill as unusable without adapting it
